text_blocks.snippet: Jardiance (empagliflozin) can cause common and serious side effects.

list.snippet: Increased urination and thirst: Passing more frequent or larger volumes of urine as the body flushes out excess glucose.
Urinary tract infections (UTIs): Burning, urgency, frequency, or cloudy/bloody urine.
Genital yeast or fungal infections: Itching, burning, swelling, pain, or thick white discharge in women or men.
Dizziness or lightheadedness: Caused by mild drops in blood pressure or fluid loss.
Dehydration and low blood pressure: Fluid loss can lead to extreme weakness, dizziness upon standing, or worsening kidney function.

Diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA): A dangerous buildup of acid in the blood, even when blood sugar levels are not extremely high, with symptoms like nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, trouble breathing, or a fruity breath odor.
Necrotizing fasciitis (Fournier’s gangrene): A rare, life-threatening bacterial infection of the tissue under the skin in the genital or perineal area.
Serious kidney infections: Pyelonephritis or urosepsis.
Lower limb amputations: An increased risk observed in patients with a history of amputation, vascular disease, or foot ulcers.
Low blood sugar (hypoglycemia): More likely if taken alongside insulin or sulfonylureas.
Severe allergic reactions: Rash, hives, or swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat.

text_blocks.snippet: Detailed prescribing information and safety guidelines are available directly through the Official Jardiance Side Effects Guide and GoodRx Jardiance Overview.
